blocks.text: The first reactions to “Clayface,” DC Studios’ first horror thriller, are now available and it looks like fans are in for quite a horrifying treat. Directed by James Watkins (“Speak No Evil”) and co-written by Mike Flanagan (“The Haunting of Hill House,” “Carrie,” “Doctor Sleep”), “Clayface” tells the story of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery, played by Tom Rhys Harries. The official synopsis reads: Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured.
